THE_SPLIT_QUESTION_IS_NOT_MINE.consequence_if_DE_rules_otherwise: the tape is rebuilt; it is one day and it is cheap relative to the fragment
THE_SPLIT_QUESTION_IS_NOT_MINE.corrected_because: REV 51 named this literal; BE round 53 FILED that the emitter now computed it. It did not: that patch used a non-asserting `.replace()` whose pattern did not match, so it silently no-opped and the false literal shipped again in THIS receipt. Found by reading the 09-04 receipt. The emitter is fixed with an assert; this receipt is superseded rather than edited.
THE_SPLIT_QUESTION_IS_NOT_MINE.mechanism: build_state_tape_v2 maps its two inputs onto the two splits: (('train', FRAG), ('score', TOP))
THE_SPLIT_QUESTION_IS_NOT_MINE.status: RULED — the day's rows are the SCORE split (R-560). A ruled forward day is not trained on.
THE_SPLIT_QUESTION_IS_NOT_MINE.what_this_build_did: day fragment -> SCORE; an explicitly EMPTY file -> TRAIN
THE_SPLIT_QUESTION_IS_NOT_MINE.why_it_bites_here: those are two POPULATIONS (eraB, top-up), not two feature sets. A one-day Gate-1 tape has ONE population, so one split has no input.

WHICH_SPLIT_THE_ASSEMBLY_SCORES_FROM_AND.corrected_from: the first 09-03 tape put the day in TRAIN and left SCORE empty; that artifact is moved aside as .WRONG_SPLIT and superseded
WHICH_SPLIT_THE_ASSEMBLY_SCORES_FROM_AND.why: a RULED FORWARD DAY is not trained on. Every row is a SCORE row that the PINNED heads score at their PINNED thetas to produce `asm`; nothing is fitted here.
WHICH_SPLIT_THE_ASSEMBLY_SCORES_FROM_AND.why_the_label_is_not_cosmetic: `phase2_arms.tape_index` filters `r['split'] != split`, so the label decides which index a row lands in -- and a forward day labelled `train` reports as a day the heads were FITTED on, which is the look-ahead-shaped misreport

train_split.why_it_still_carries_a_digest: REV 43: 'empty by construction' is a claim about the file, and a claim about a file that carries no digest cannot be checked. An empty file is still bytes.

supersedes.what_changed: TWO PROSE FIELDS ONLY -- `what_this_build_did` (was false of the build) and `status` (was PROVISIONAL on a question R-560 ruled). No number moves; the tape is the same bytes.
